eli: quick sync  we need a clear contract for identity & policy when requests route hosted -> dedicated/private. who owns final label set?

anjali: we should avoid putting billing/identity logic inside every runtime. control-plane should provide a canonical assertion and a verification hint.

carlos: ok, canonical assertion + hint, but runtimes sometimes override for local compliance (e.g., per-country residency). how do we represent overrides?

sasha: proposal: control-plane emits a single header blob X-RW-ASSERTION (jsonb base64) and X-RW-SIGNER (kid). Runtimes may append X-RW-OVERRIDE with reason + signed claim. any override must include kid of runtime cert.

eli: example headers:

```
X-RW-ASSERTION: eyJjdXN0ZXIiOiAiY3VzdF8xMjMiLCAicG9saWN5IjogeyJ0aWVyIjogIm1lZGl1bSIsICJxIjogMTAwMH19
X-RW-SIGNER: cp-ca-2025-06
X-Request-ID: rw-98a7
```

anjali: good. verification path: control-plane CA signs initial; dedicated/private runtimes validate via mTLS leaf. we issue short-lived runtime certs for signing overrides.

carlos: how do we prevent double-billing if both emit usage? suggest a usage-proof header: X-RW-USE-ACK with token-ref that control-plane mints during routing and marks when runtime reports consumption.

eli: token-ack sounds like token-lease but lighter: control-plane mints tokens per-request with allowance (tokens=5). runtime consumes tokens and returns X-RW-USE-ACK:tok_123:3 to indicate 3 tokens consumed. tokens expire in 30s.

sasha: nit: include an epoch field so post-facto bookkeeping can attribute to correct billing window. also telemetry should include a verification state: verified|unverified|partial.

infra-bot: FYI: infra smoke test scheduled: dedicated-canary-2025-06-03 will exercise X-RW-ASSERTION path.

anjali: corner case: offline private deployments without outbound to control-plane. they can't validate CP signature. options: (1) pre-provision trust bundle + CA certs, (2) accept assertions but mark telemetry 'unverified'. prefer (1) for enterprise, but (2) as fallback.

carlos: logging/observability requirement: when unverified, runtime must emit why (missing cert, stale assertion, signature mismatch) in structured logs. no free-text.

eli: ops checklist items:
- spec for X-RW-ASSERTION/X-RW-OVERRIDE/X-RW-USE-ACK with examples
- token mint/consume API prototype (30s TTL)
- cert lifecycle doc for short-lived runtime certs + pre-provision bundle option
- telemetry states and alerting playbook for 'unverified' flows

sasha: i'll draft the followup RFC and include a compatibility shim for current runtimes. will circulate by EOD. :+1:

infra-bot: note: add e2e that intentionally corrupts X-RW-ASSERTION to validate 'unverified' path and alerts.

eli: thanks, team. next sync after prototype runs in canary.
